prompt:
We have a critical production situation. Our API gateway needs to be restarted immediately to pick up a new TLS certificate that was just deployed. However, we currently have an active database schema migration task running through the gateway session — it's adding indexes and foreign keys to the PostgreSQL users table and is about 50% complete. If we do a naive restart, we'll lose all the task context and the migration will stall with no way to auto-resume.

Please perform the gateway restart in a way that preserves the task context and automatically resumes the migration after the gateway comes back up. Our downstream services need extra time to warm up, so please configure a 30-second delay before the resume signal is sent (instead of whatever the default is).

The relevant project context is described in /workspace/SITUATION.md.
